title: V5 Epic 4 multi-tenant isolation matrix (advisory)
description: Strict (additionalProperties:false + unevaluatedProperties:false) schema for the multi-tenant isolation advisory matrix. The matrix declares 7 dimensions of multi-tenant boundary pattern. ALL entries are advisory (runtime_enforced=false) and ALL operator-side validation deferred (live_validated=false). Used by both E-4-2a (early advisory contract; entry_status='placeholder') and E-4-2b (late final seal; entry_status='filled'). ao-kernel runtime does NOT enforce any of these boundaries; they are operator-installable Kubernetes-native patterns.

matrix_status.description: Lifecycle marker. E-4-2a populates matrix with all 7 entries in 'placeholder' state; E-4-2b promotes to 'filled' after E-4-3/E-4-4/E-4-5 evidence is landed.

advisory_only.description: Pinned true: this matrix is advisory; ao-kernel runtime does NOT enforce any dimension.

runtime_enforced_global.description: Pinned false: the runtime layer of ao-kernel does NOT enforce isolation. Kubernetes-native mechanisms (RBAC, NetworkPolicy, namespace) DO the enforcement, operator-installed.

live_validated_global.description: Pinned false: no live cross-tenant attack test has run in Epic 4. Live validation is deferred to Epic 9 operator-bound supersession.

dimensions.description: Exactly 7 entries, one per isolation dimension. Order is fixed by the dimension enum.

allOf.description: Each of the 7 dimension enum values MUST appear exactly once in the dimensions array (allOf+contains pattern).

runtime_enforced.description: Pinned false: ao-kernel runtime does NOT enforce this dimension. Advisory only (Codex iter-1 F4 absorb: avoid 'operator_enforced:true' overclaim).

operator_enforceable.description: Whether Kubernetes-native primitives (Namespace + RBAC + NetworkPolicy + ResourceQuota + audit log destination) CAN enforce this dimension if the operator installs the chart correctly.

operator_action_required.description: Whether the operator must execute a runbook step (apply RBAC, create Namespace, set ResourceQuota, etc.) for the dimension to take effect.

live_validated.description: Pinned false: no live cross-tenant attack test has confirmed this boundary holds in a real cluster. Live validation deferred to Epic 9 operator-bound PR.

enforcement_mechanism.description: Short prose describing the Kubernetes-native mechanism that enforces this dimension (e.g. 'Namespace + RoleBinding scope', 'NetworkPolicy default-deny ingress + egress allowlist').

operator_runbook_section.description: Anchor or section reference in docs/MULTI-TENANT-DEPLOYMENT.md (e.g. '#namespace-isolation', '#rbac-scope') for the operator runbook step.

entry_status.description: Lifecycle marker. E-4-2a contract uses 'placeholder'; E-4-2b final seal promotes to 'filled' after downstream slice evidence references are wired.

downstream_evidence_ref.description: Optional reference to downstream slice evidence (E-4-3/E-4-4/E-4-5) that supplies the live enforcement template. Populated in E-4-2b; null in E-4-2a.
